log.out:
# checksum

Map each character to a value: '0'-'9' -> 0-9, 'A'-'Z' -> 10-35. Walk the values from the RIGHT. Every second value (the 2nd, 4th, ... from the right) is doubled; if a doubled value exceeds 35, subtract 35. Sum all values. checksum(s) = (36 - sum mod 36) mod 36.

Example: checksum("A1") -> values [10, 1]; from the right, 1 stays 1, 10 doubles to 20; sum 21; (36 - 21) mod 36 = 15.
